events.question: Which Rho-Bank credit card currently offers the highest cash back for everyday purchases, and what are its cash back rates and any category limits or caps?

facts_found: The Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases (flat rate, not category-limited). [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Platinum Rewards Card cash back applies to daily purchases across all categories 'without rotating caps'. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Platinum Rewards Card eligible transactions are point-of-sale and online purchases posted to the account; cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, and other cash-equivalent transactions are not eligible. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Returns or credits reduce previously earned Platinum Rewards Card cash back on a per-transaction basis. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Platinum Rewards Card rewards can be redeemed once the available rewards balance reaches at least $15. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Platinum Rewards Card has a $200.00 annual fee, which should be considered when calculating net rewards. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Platinum Rewards Card offers a $150.00 annual-fee rebate when a monthly spend threshold of $7,500.00 is met. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]
Platinum Rewards Card has 0% foreign transaction fees and purchase protection up to 135 days with a maximum of $17,500 per claim. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]
The Diamond Elite Card earns 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases, with redemption available once the rewards balance reaches at least 5. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]

The Diamond Elite Card carries a $495.00 annual fee, 15.99% purchase APR, and credit limits of $37,500 to $375,000; it is classified as an invitation-tier card. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_002]
The Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases with a $0.00 annual fee (requires Rho-Bank+ premium subscription). [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back only on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
The Green Rewards Card earns 3.0% cash back at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants and 1.0% on other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]
The Bronze Rewards Card earns a flat 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases with no annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]

The EcoCard is points-based (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases), not a percentage cash back card; all Rho-Bank cash back cards' stored points convert at 1 point = $0.01. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Rho-Bank reward categories include Travel, Dining, Groceries, Entertainment, Shopping, Utilities, Transportation, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, and Operations; each card has its own bonus categories and default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]

open_questions: No explicit numeric annual or per-period dollar cap on Platinum Rewards Card cash back is documented; the KB only states there are no rotating category caps.
Platinum Rewards Card eligibility requirements (minimum credit score, subscription requirements) were not found in the retrieved documents.
Business Platinum Rewards Card cash back rates were not found in the knowledge base.
Diamond Elite Card invitation/eligibility criteria were not documented beyond its invitation-tier classification.
